description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams' used as a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee allowed skills in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameters class and includes a property for employee number, along with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for filtering employee allowed skills by employee number, extending base filter parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with default sort field 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
